{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Redefine conversion as status == 'completed'
sales_df['conversion'] = (sales_df['status'] == 'completed').astype(int)

# Compute conversion rates within each customer segment
segment_rates = sales_df.groupby(['channel', 'customer_segment'])['conversion'].mean().unstack(level='customer_segment')

# Compute difference in conversion rates within each segment (email - paid_search)
differences_by_segment = segment_rates.loc['email'] - segment_rates.loc['paid_search']

# Compute overall segment proportions (to use as weights)
overall_segment_proportions = sales_df['customer_segment'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Compute weighted average difference (using overall segment distribution as weights)
weighted_difference = (differences_by_segment * overall_segment_proportions).sum()

# Output results
print("Conversion rates by channel and segment:")
print(segment_rates)
print("\nDifference in conversion rates by segment (email - paid_search):")
print(differences_by_segment)
print(f"\nWeighted average difference (email - paid_search): {weighted_difference}")"}
